0022600026.text: The Boston Celtics (6-2, on a one-game winning streak and 1.5 games back in the Atlantic) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-6, on a five-game losing streak and 2 games back in the Southeast) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game. Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with illness, while Jayson Tatum and Payton Pritchard are listed as day-to-day with rest and an eye abrasion, respectively, and are game-time decisions. Charlotte is missing Grant Williams, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Kon Knueppel is day-to-day with leg soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 113-102 win in Boston on April 7.
